about.label: About us
about.title: Two generations. One team.
about.subtitle: Hardware and software repair, from the circuit board to the operating system.
about.placeholder: [Add a photo of you and your dad]
about.story: AbdelFix is a father-and-son team. My dad is an electrical engineer with more than 25 years of experience repairing phones and tablets. I am a software engineer, and I have worked beside him for over six years. Between us we cover both halves of every repair: the hardware that breaks and the software that makes it run.
about.hardwareText: Repairs phones and tablets down to the components on the board, finding the exact fault instead of swapping parts and hoping.
about.softwareText: Handles system repair, recovery, updates and diagnostics, and gets your device running right again.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Good questions.
faq.subtitle: The things people ask us first.
faq.q1: How does pickup and delivery work?
faq.a1: Send us your request, and we agree a time to collect your device from your address in Barcelona or Badalona. We repair it and bring it back to your door.
faq.q2: Is pickup and delivery really free?
faq.a2: Yes. Pickup and delivery are free in Barcelona and Badalona.
faq.q3: Will I know the price before you start?
faq.a3: Yes. We check the problem first and tell you the price before we repair anything. If you do not want to go ahead, there is no obligation.
faq.q4: How long does a repair take?
faq.a4: Many repairs, like screens and batteries, are done the same day or within 24 hours. Harder hardware problems can take longer, and we will tell you the time when we give you the price.
faq.a5: Yes, every repair comes with a warranty. We will tell you exactly how long it lasts when we confirm your repair.
faq.q6: What if you cannot fix my device?
faq.a6: We will tell you honestly, and you will not be charged for a repair we could not complete.
faq.a7: Yes. We repair phones and tablets, hardware and software, from all the major brands.
